_about: The TPS cover letter (src/fill/cover_letter.py): the firm's letterhead, signer and closing from the I-485 letter. The address (the lockbox on the country's own TPS page, by state), the subject and the fees (Form G-1055 10/01/26) come from src/tps.py. DRAFT: the attorney approves this file before volume use.

checklist.text: Cover letter: the attorney signs it.

Enclose each fee the cover letter states by its own Form G-1450 (a U.S. card) or Form G-1650 (a U.S. bank account), never a check: the I-821, its biometric services fee, the I-765, its Pub. L. 119-21 fee.
